current.text: The Lakers have two open starting spots. Grimes, LaRavia and Mamukelashvili are the main candidates.
Whoever comes off the Lakers bench in that group is expected to still play about 27 minutes.
LeBron James left the Lakers for the Sixers and Rui Hachimura appears to be gone. This frees up usage for the players who remain.
Experts expect him to start and play about 30 minutes. One expert says the starting role is not confirmed yet.
Ziaire Williams might also start for the Lakers, which could cut into the open starting spots.
If a top Lakers player gets hurt, he becomes the number two option with top 80 upside. That makes him some insurance on Luka Doncic, whose health is a known risk.
He is a last-round flyer as a likely starter.

durable.text: He is a point of attack defender who can also score and handle the ball.

note: Grimes is priced at about 1 USD on Yahoo and ESPN, with ranks of 126 and 118. That puts him near the bottom of our 144-player draft, so he works as a 1 USD last-round flyer or as an early waiver pickup. His projected line has no weak category, with threes as his best category and FG% his softest, so he fits any build. He gains upside if Luka misses time. In the first weeks, check whether he starts and plays about 30 minutes, since LaRavia, Mamukelashvili and Ziaire Williams are also competing for the open starting spots.
